parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is **1**. Valid values: **1** to **100000**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of protection rules to return on each page. The default value is **20**. Valid values: an integer from **1** to **500**.

parameters.name: QueryArgs
parameters.description:
The query conditions. This parameter is a JSON string.

> If you do not specify this parameter, all protection rules are queried.
